tools.name: get_promotion_allocation_offer
tools.description: Get KillionApps' experimental $5 ecommerce promotion-capital allocation offer, free validation route, paid MPP route, and discovery URLs.

tools.name: validate_promotion_allocation_request
tools.description: Validate a portfolio payload for free before purchasing. This does not execute the allocation or charge a payment.

tools.name: get_promotion_allocation_schema
tools.description: Get the KillionApps platform-neutral promotion allocation input and output schema summary. This tool is free.

tools.name: purchase_promotion_allocation
tools.description: Validate a portfolio and return the existing REST/MPP purchase handoff. This MCP tool never fakes or bypasses payment; an MPP-capable HTTP client must complete the Stripe challenge at the paid endpoint.
